title: Community competition: Show your best ‘Storm Stories’
body:
# Community competition: Show your best ‘Storm Stories’

Raiders,

It’s rough weather out there!

We’ve watched Raiders get swept right off Spaceport Tower, ARC machines ambushing Raiders as they emerge from the fog, and buggy shields leaving Raiders exposed and helpless.

We want to see even more of this - which is why we’re running a competition inviting players to send in their standout Hurricane moments for a shot at winning an **exclusive Raider Kit** loaded with rare **ARC Raiders merch and trinkets!** Ten runners-up will each receive **2400 Raider Tokens** as a thank-you for their entries.

A panel of ARC Raiders developers will review a shortlist of entries and choose the grand prize winner along with the 10 runners-up. Both the winner and the runners-up will appear in a special Hurricane-themed Community Highlights video - good luck!

# **Raider Kit**

The grand prize winner will receive a **Raider Kit** containing:

* Cassette player

* Bluetooth headphones

* ARC Raiders selected soundtrack on cassette tape

* Polaroid Go camera and film

* Vinyl sticker pack

* Raider multi-tool

* Embroidered Cotopaxi bag

# **How to enter:**

The **‘Storm Stories’** competition runs from March 7th through March 21st. To submit a video for judging:

* Follow **ARC Raiders** on X.

* Like and repost the Promotion post.

* Reply to the Promotion post with your video, tagged with the designated hashtag (#ARCSTORMSTORIES).

**Video requirements:** 16:9 aspect ratio, 1920×1080 resolution (1080p), MP4 or AVI format, maximum file size of 1GB, and the footage must show enjoyable ARC Raiders moments from the Hurricane event.

**Entry limit:** Only one submission is allowed per account. Entries must arrive within the Promotion Period to qualify.

Full Terms and Conditions are available for review in a separate document.
